reviewTriggers: new critical dependency version or feature
new build script or proc-macro capability

criticalDependencies.reviewBoundary: primitive choice, key handling, FFI, unsafe code, enabled algorithms, and release provenance
message framing, certificate verification, protocol state machines, parser limits, and unsafe or platform code
untrusted-input handling, recursion and allocation bounds, ambiguity, and format compatibility
RFC 8264 and RFC 8265 conformance, bundled Unicode table generation, disallowed-code-point handling, normalization ambiguity, and build-time network isolation
decompression limits, native-code boundaries, memory use, and malformed-stream behavior
query binding, object-key and conditional-write semantics, TLS, cloud credential handling, protocol parsing, and migration compatibility
API version selection, authentication, TLS, watch-stream parsing, and controller retry behavior

lifecycleScripts.rationale: tsx uses esbuild's install hook to select the exact platform-specific compiler binary. OxiBelt CI and release installs retain --ignore-scripts.

exceptions.subject: Cargo.lock@sha256:13abc720f2886f0b168833250c7e767832b4f0c85590eaed314c2dc368450ffb
exceptions.rationale: The exact current set of simultaneous semver compatibility lines is frozen while upstream dependency convergence work removes it. The development-only proptest graph adds exact rand 0.9, rand_chacha 0.9, and rand_core 0.9 lines tracked by https://github.com/OxiBelt/OxiBelt/issues/172; any further line fails the static admission test.

exceptions.subject: Cargo.lock@sha256:13abc720f2886f0b168833250c7e767832b4f0c85590eaed314c2dc368450ffb
exceptions.rationale: Initial cargo-vet adoption records the exact current exemption inventory while imported and local audits replace it. During an explicitly approved dependency refresh, obsolete exact-version exemptions may be replaced by the selected exact versions; wildcard exemptions, criteria broadening, and unrelated expansion remain forbidden, and every inventory hash or count change triggers static review.

exceptions.subject: precis-core@0.1.11:safe-to-deploy
exceptions.rationale: OxiBelt uses this safe Rust RFC 8264 implementation only through bounded TURN credential inputs. Its build script generates tables from checksum-bound crate resources, and the optional networking feature is disabled.

exceptions.subject: precis-profiles@0.1.13:safe-to-deploy
exceptions.rationale: OxiBelt uses OpaqueString enforcement for RFC 8489 TURN long-term keys and USERHASH. Inputs remain byte-bounded, invalid code points fail closed, and optional build-time networking is disabled.

exceptions.subject: precis-tools@0.1.9:safe-to-deploy
exceptions.rationale: This build-only generator reads checksum-bound Unicode resources and writes generated Rust under Cargo OUT_DIR. Its optional reqwest-backed networking feature is disabled.

exceptions.subject: regex-lite@0.1.9:safe-to-deploy
exceptions.rationale: This safe Rust parser is reachable only through build-time parsing of checksum-bound Unicode resources for RFC 8265 tables.

exceptions.subject: ucd-parse@0.1.13:safe-to-deploy
exceptions.rationale: This safe build-only parser consumes fixed crate-bundled Unicode data for RFC 8264 and RFC 8265 table generation without runtime or network authority.

exceptions.subject: kube-client@4.2.0:safe-to-deploy
exceptions.rationale: Whole-crate certification remains withheld because the optional HTTPS proxy connector can reuse cluster TLS roots and identity. OxiBelt keeps kube-client's HTTP and SOCKS proxy features disabled and seals its client construction behind a tested direct-transport adapter that rejects loaded proxy settings and disabled certificate verification before client creation.

exceptions.subject: web-transport-trait@0.4.0:safe-to-deploy
exceptions.rationale: Whole-crate certification remains withheld because the generic async RecvStream::read_buf default transmutes BufMut spare capacity to a mutable byte slice and advances it without enforcing that a safe implementation returned a size within initialized storage. Version 0.4.0 adds poll::RecvStream::poll_read_buf and poll_read_chunk with the same unchecked pattern. OxiBelt confines WebTransport to a private adapter that uses web-transport-quinn's Tokio AsyncRead path into initialized storage and rejects direct generic, raw, or poll receive APIs outside that boundary; retain this exact-version exception pending an upstream redesign or dependency removal.

exceptions.subject: buffered-reader@1.4.1:LGPL-2.0-or-later
exceptions.rationale: Sequoia uses this streaming parser internally; keep the copyleft license scoped to the exact reviewed crate version.

exceptions.subject: clubcard@0.3.4:MPL-2.0
exceptions.rationale: CRLite uses this exact package for probabilistic certificate-revocation data; keep MPL approval package-local.

exceptions.subject: clubcard-crlite@0.6.2:MPL-2.0
exceptions.rationale: OxiBelt's CRLite integration directly relies on this exact MPL-licensed implementation.

exceptions.subject: sequoia-openpgp@2.4.1:LGPL-2.0-or-later
exceptions.rationale: The CLI signing and verification boundary requires Sequoia; approval remains limited to the exact reviewed release.
